name: matrix_ops
description: Exact matrix arithmetic over fractions: determinant, inverse, rank, reduced row echelon form, transpose, product, and A x = b solved and classified as one solution, none, or infinitely many with the general solution in the free variables. Decimal entries are exact (0.1 is 1/10), so singularity is decided without tolerances. Up to 30 x 30.

matrix.description: Rows; numbers, decimal or fraction strings

catalog.source: Gauss-Jordan elimination over exact rationals (G. Strang, Introduction to Linear Algebra, ch. 2 and 3); examples from Wikipedia's Gaussian elimination article
